title: Event hub — Luma pattern
question: Luma’s tabs + right/bottom panels are locked. How should Details and header compose in Honest Clubhouse?

options.label: Overview-led Details
options.thesis: Header sheds the cover. Details owns the event: preview + when/where, Edit / Change photo panels, Hosts, read-only Visibility.
options.viewport: Title + peer tabs (Details · Registrations · Forms · Settings). Details opens on a two-column overview; Edit and Change photo slide a drawer / sheet.
options.risk: Header loses the glanceable cover until you open Details.

options.label: Keep cover in header
options.thesis: Approved header cover stays for session identity. Details still gets Luma overview sections and panel edits; cover isn’t duplicated in the body.
options.viewport: Constrained 16:9 header + tabs. Details: when/where summary, Hosts, Visibility; Edit / Change photo open panels.
options.risk: Can feel like two headers if Details also shows a big preview.

options.label: Quiet header + preview card
options.thesis: Header is title, meta, Event page only—no cover. Details leads with one quiet preview card beside when/where, then Hosts and Visibility.
options.viewport: Minimal header band. Details overview card with photo; actions open the same drawer / sheet grammar as Registrations.
options.risk: Less Luma density if the preview card is too soft.
